From a1f3316dd7b5ce740c774697c664e2e60d095794 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "David S. Miller" <davem@davemloft.net>
Date: Thu, 21 Sep 2017 18:18:23 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] ipv4: Move fib_has_custom_local_routes outside of
 IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES.

> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c: In function 'fib_validate_source':
> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c:411:16: error: 'struct netns_ipv4' has no member named 'fib_has_custom_local_routes'
>    if (net->ipv4.fib_has_custom_local_routes)
>                 ^
> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c: In function 'inet_rtm_newroute':
> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c:773:12: error: 'struct netns_ipv4' has no member named 'fib_has_custom_local_routes'
>    net->ipv4.fib_has_custom_local_routes = true;
>             ^

Fixes: 6e617de84e87 ("net: avoid a full fib lookup when rp_filter is disabled.")
Reported-by: Stephen Rothwell <sfr@canb.auug.org.au>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/include/net/netns/ipv4.h b/include/net/netns/ipv4.h
index 20720721da4b..8387f099115e 100644
--- a/include/net/netns/ipv4.h
+++ b/include/net/netns/ipv4.h
@@ -49,10 +49,10 @@ struct netns_ipv4 {
 #ifdef CONFIG_IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES
 	struct fib_rules_ops	*rules_ops;
 	bool			fib_has_custom_rules;
-	bool			fib_has_custom_local_routes;
 	struct fib_table __rcu	*fib_main;
 	struct fib_table __rcu	*fib_default;
 #endif
+	bool			fib_has_custom_local_routes;
 #ifdef CONFIG_IP_ROUTE_CLASSID
 	int			fib_num_tclassid_users;
 #endif
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `include/net/netns/ipv4.h`**
   - The member `fib_has_custom_local_routes` has been moved from a conditional compilation block protected by `CONFIG_IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES` to be placed outside of that block.
   - This change allows `fib_has_custom_local_routes` to always be a part of the `struct netns_ipv4`, regardless of whether `CONFIG_IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES` is defined.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The relocation of `fib_has_custom_local_routes` from a conditional section to an unconditional state indicates a refactor aimed at ensuring that the structure always contains this member. This change was prompted by compilation errors indicating that `fib_has_custom_local_routes` is expected to exist but was not defined in the appropriate structure, particularly during operations that involve the validation of source routing and the updating of routing tables.
- The commit connects to previous changes that might be related to route filtering logic, reinforcing the cohesiveness of related functionalities by ensuring that custom local routes can be referenced consistently throughout the codebase. It addresses the bug report regarding the missing member to improve the reliability of routing operations.

Here is the commit message:
ipv4: Move fib_has_custom_local_routes outside of
 IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES.

> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c: In function 'fib_validate_source':
> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c:411:16: error: 'struct netns_ipv4' has no member named 'fib_has_custom_local_routes'
>    if (net->ipv4.fib_has_custom_local_routes)
>                 ^
> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c: In function 'inet_rtm_newroute':
> net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c:773:12: error: 'struct netns_ipv4' has no member named 'fib_has_custom_local_routes'
>    net->ipv4.fib_has_custom_local_routes = true;
>             ^

Fixes: 6e617de84e87 ("net: avoid a full fib lookup when rp_filter is disabled.")
Reported-by: Stephen Rothwell <sfr@canb.auug.org.au>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

Here is the root cause:
The root cause of the bug is that the struct `netns_ipv4` did not contain the member `fib_has_custom_local_routes` when it was being accessed in the functions `fib_validate_source` and `inet_rtm_newroute`. This resulted in compilation errors indicating that the member was missing. The conditional compilation based on `CONFIG_IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES` led to this member being unavailable in certain contexts where it was required, causing the inconsistency and errors.

Here is the patch:
 	struct fib_rules_ops	*rules_ops;
 	bool			fib_has_custom_rules;
-	bool			fib_has_custom_local_routes;
 	struct fib_table __rcu	*fib_main;
 	struct fib_table __rcu	*fib_default;
 #endif
+	bool			fib_has_custom_local_routes;
 #ifdef CONFIG_IP_ROUTE_CLASSID
 	int			fib_num_tclassid_users;

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (net->ipv4.fib_has_custom_local_routes)
net->ipv4.fib_has_custom_local_routes = true;
```
Reason:
The struct `netns_ipv4` did not contain the member `fib_has_custom_local_routes` due to conditional compilation based on `CONFIG_IP_MULTIPLE_TABLES`. This led to compilation errors when the code attempted to access or modify this member in the functions `fib_validate_source` and `inet_rtm_newroute`, resulting in the reported errors.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
bool fib_has_custom_local_routes;
```
Reason:
By moving the declaration of `fib_has_custom_local_routes` outside of the conditional compilation block, it ensures that this member is always available in the `struct netns_ipv4`, thus resolving the compilation errors and allowing the functions to access and modify this member as intended.
